title: Eka is worth $1.45B thanks to a physical AI model that has experts raving
snippet: Eka Robotics may be the first robotic arm that is actually good at picking a wide range of objects up, and it is so smooth and human-like, it is wowing the industry.

title: Inspired Capital closes $450M fourth fund as New York pushes back on Silicon Valley’s gravitational pull
snippet: The raise comes as venture dollars pile up on the West Coast.

title: Spotify launches paid podcast memberships with perks beyond bonus content
snippet: Spotify's new paid memberships let podcasters offer fans exclusive perks, including ad-free listening, early access, and bonus content, while keeping 90% of the revenue.
